sigkill_admission_assessment.reason: An untrappable termination before the final attempt seal yields a missing/invalid admission artifact and must be rejected. A termination after the final attempt seal but before runner_success occurs only after output/input/cgroup/initial/final checks have completed, so admission is safe.
mandatory_downstream_requirements: Make --attempt-dir required and require the fixed isolated-repo M511 attempt path; reject symlink capture/attempt paths.
Require exact initial and top-level member populations and validate both levels of member and outer seals.
Require the top-level seal to commit exactly initial/SHA256SUMS.seal.sha256 and POSTCAPTURE_PASS.txt.
Parse initial/identity.sha256 and require canonical runner SHA 788d674eb3df23f3af6cd8525b3a6471fd26596459e298ef8c9df7aa6369b7fa plus the pinned producer/contract/review/docs identities.
Cross-bind ATTEMPT_CONSUMED repo_root/output/status and POSTCAPTURE_PASS manifest/seal/status/claim-boundary fields to the actual capture.
Cross-check cgroup start/end: failcnt zero and unchanged, under_oom zero, oom_kill unchanged.
Perform all attempt admission checks before decoding payload or publishing verifier PASS.

p1_findings.finding: The current payload verifier SHA 5a83c45f... has no required --attempt-dir and does not pin the reviewed runner SHA or final runner attempt seal.
p1_findings.disposition: This does not block producing the one-shot capture, but it blocks all payload admission and downstream consumption until a revised verifier is independently reviewed.

p1_findings.finding: POSTCAPTURE_PASS.txt is written before the initial nested seals are revalidated. A failure cannot produce the final top-level seal, so mandatory final-seal admission remains safe, but an unsealed PASS-named text file may mislead manual inspection.
p1_findings.recommended_fix: Optionally move the initial member/outer seal recheck immediately before creating POSTCAPTURE_PASS.txt.

decision.reason: The r1 rollback P0 is closed. The untrappable termination window is safely handled by mandatory cross-artifact final-attempt admission, which must be implemented and reviewed before payload consumption.
decision.next_action: Run only with both exact literal environment values after confirming output and attempt absent. Independently review the revised attempt-aware payload verifier before any downstream use.
